candidate.allocation_note: Compared the user's working plan (current) against remaining concerns (qualification). qualification_review.interpretation: The user is concerned that their chosen constraints will waste Lina's hands-on learning mechanism and cause Northline to interpret the discovery phase as a soft rejection.
qualification_review.limitations: These behavioral and relationship risks could force the user to adjust the discovery constraints or reopen the plan if early sessions fail or stall.

records.fidelity_note: Captures the user's provisional three-part plan to schedule discovery sessions with Northline without committing to writing production code, while simultaneously establishing their reliability and roadmap commitments before deciding.
records.limitations: This plan is provisional and explicitly pauses code development, leaving the actual decision on roadmap integration open.
records.role_interpretation: The user's active provisional decision and testing process, including boundaries implemented to prevent premature scope creep.

Then we decide with all three pieces visible.
